'''NCWildKarrde Tatooine Based Deck.''' is a [[Light]] constructed list published on [[Game Players Network]].

== Deck info ==
* '''Player:''' [[NCWildKarrde]]
* '''Published:''' 26 March 2003 (Game Players Network)
* '''GPN category:''' Standard
* '''Format:''' [[Premiere - Tatooine]]
* '''Side:''' [[Light]]
* '''Starting Card:''' {{CardLink|Tatooine: Jawa Camp|Premiere-L-tatooinejawacamp.gif}}
* '''Strategy:''' Tatooine: Jawa Camp
* '''GEMP Importable deck:''' [[Media:PTat Tatooine Jawa Camp NCWildKarrde LS.txt |Download]]

== Introduction ==

There is a tournament based on Tatooine. Basically, Tatooine is the only planet in which locations can be deployed.

The published list has 59 cards.

== Strategy ==

First turn you get out S-Foils and Squadron Assignments. The trick is to get Geezum out and begin deploying Tatooine Locations. Get Luke, Qui-Gon, or Obi to Tosche Station, for extra force generation. Uncontrollable Fury will help with Darth vader, cause just about everyone uses a Vader. Old Ben allows me to retrieve my lost characters, while the bacta tank helps with protection. The Fleet is just big enough to help defend against the Imperial Fleet if they bring one. I forgot to mention that this is a non-objective tourney, it is straight old school battle plan. I also do not own any EPP hence why they do not appear. Any cards that you think would help the cause in this style tournament please let me know. Also base the rating on the style tournament not the overall deck for all other contest.
